research.text: My research focuses on developing and applying novel causal inference methods to inform decisions, with a substantive focus on pregnancy and cardiovascular health. research.text: Research in Prof. Jonathan Pober’s group focuses on developing new techniques for studying the Epoch of Reionization and associated Cosmic Dawn, when the first stars and galaxies illuminated the early Universe.
